hook: I want every tenant's first 48 hours to feel safe

builtFor.context: HousingAnywhere wants to be a trusted companion beyond the booking. The moment that tests that trust most is move-in: a new country, a new room, and 48 hours of protection that tenants don't always know how to use.

opportunities.title: Move-in Check
opportunities.body: A countdown and a short room checklist that make the 48-hour protection window usable.

opportunities.title: Payments you can follow
opportunities.body: Show when the first month is held, released or refunded, in the app, not a help article.

opportunities.title: Reports with proof
opportunities.body: One-tap reports with photos that support can judge quickly.

body: Most of my work has been money moments on mobile: a lending app at Shecluded, a wallet-first checkout at Foodlify, and verification tools at Youverify.
I make ideas tangible early and prototype with AI tools, which is how I built the working concept in this pitch.

bring.title: Mobile money moments
bring.body: A loan dashboard redesign that lifted first-time engagement by 30%.

bring.title: Marketplace experience
bring.body: Checkout and ordering for a B2B marketplace, helping lift repeat orders by 31%.

bring.title: AI-assisted prototyping
bring.body: Working mobile prototypes in code, like the one in this pitch.

systemsGets: Someone who can design one high-trust moment, like move-in day, and turn it into patterns the whole post-booking journey and design system can reuse.

opportunity.title: Move-in Check
opportunity.problem: The first month is held until 48 hours after move-in, but the window lives in a help article. Tenants can't always confirm a move-in time, and some report problems inside the window and hear nothing.
opportunity.solution: Show the payment timeline before move-in, a countdown and room checklist on the day, and a one-tap report with photos that keeps the payment held and promises a reply time.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how tenants experience move-in and payments, then contributing one useful improvement with the team.

days.body: Meet Product, Engineering, Research, Data and the operations team. Learn the roadmap and the design system.
Review move-in support contacts, cancel requests and app data.
Agree on one moment to improve, grounded in evidence.
Prototype it with AI tools, and review edge cases with an engineer and ops.
Share findings, the prototype, the trade-offs and a plan to test it with tenants.

ask: I'd love to bring mobile fintech and marketplace design experience, and fast, AI-assisted prototyping, to HousingAnywhere's post-booking journey.
